purpose: Teach: たべ/横たわっ/のる/盗み/名乗り/注が/申し述べ/惜しみ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと夕飯をたべるのが楽しみだった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I used to look forward to having dinner with Father.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Pause before speaking, as if reaching back through decades. Warm but melancholy. Voice trails slightly at the end, lingering in the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、畳に横たわってお昼寝されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandfather would stretch out on the tatami for his afternoon nap, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing smile in the voice. Tender nostalgia without sadness. A small laugh folded into the memory. Warm, intimate tone directed at her husband, checking that he remembers too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが馬にのる時に田んぼを巡られた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would ride his horse across the rice fields.
lines.style: Voice opens with wonder, picturing the scene. Slower cadence, allowing the image to settle. Quiet reverence for the memory. Soft fade, like watching a figure disappear into distance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫の盗みっこ遊びに付き合ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandfather would play that sneaking-game with us grandchildren, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Playful warmth breaking through. A small, genuine laugh underneath. Voice brightens slightly at the memory of him joining in. Affectionate teasing in the tone, reaching toward him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは家紋を名乗りで誇りに仰った
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father spoke with such pride about our family crest.
lines.style: Respectful, measured delivery. Voice carries dignity without stiffness. Pause before naming the crest, honoring its weight. Quiet conviction underneath. Lingering slightly on the memory of his bearing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お酒を注がれる時の所作が美しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, the way he'd pour sake — such grace in every gesture, wasn't there?
lines.style: Admiring, almost lyrical quality. Voice slows to appreciate the memory of his careful movements. Tender observation. Not questioning, but inviting him to feel her witnessing of him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは家訓を申し述べて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father taught us the family motto with such care.
lines.style: Solemn, grounded tone. Deliberate pacing, each word carrying weight. Voice steady with the importance of what was passed down. Quiet reverence for the teaching moment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様に時間を惜しみなく注がれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, you gave your time to us grandchildren so freely, didn't you?
lines.style: Voice wavers slightly with tender emotion. Soft, intimate. Not a question but a loving acknowledgment. Reaches toward him with gratitude. Slight breathiness as affection surfaces.
